purpose: Calibrate composition classification against one known positive and one known non-identifiable Ordivon case, then select only naturally identifiable current cross-owner candidates for later execution.

negative.forbiddenTreatment: Do not disable ambient/direct capability merely to make proper-subset arms fail.

candidateFamilies.hypothesis: Operational representation can change regime-relative achievable methods/frontiers even when the intended semantic referent is preserved.
Owner-preserving composition may create adversarial rebinding/continuation capability unavailable from any proper subset under migration, stale relation evidence and independent consequence truth.
Observer/operation-relative mediation plus semantic adequacy plus bounded cognition may change effective Agent capability beyond raw context quantity.
Authoritative world transition, intelligent opposition and institutional authority may jointly create strategic regimes absent from pairwise subsets.
A real read-only capital decision may require a joint route/capability/current external truth/feasibility composition that cannot be attributed to one owner alone.
candidateFamilies.authorityCeiling: read-only; no financial write; no artificial route failure

admissionCriteria: Natural current consumer or workload exists.
Target outcome/transition is owner-native or independently verifiable.
Candidate owner factors are semantically independent responsibilities.
Proper-subset interventions are feasible without manufacturing missing capability.
Joint success is not definitionally equivalent to the conjunction of input labels.
A holdout, neighboring-world variation or materially different transfer route can be named before stronger emergence claims.
phaseTransitionGuard: A discrete factorial on/off interaction is insufficient. Require a parameterized neighboring-condition sweep and replicated qualitative regime change.
stopRule: If no candidate satisfies admission criteria, emit NO_CURRENT_JOINT_EXPERIMENT and wait for natural owner pressure rather than constructing a positive case.
